# Harness wheel

`react_agent_harness-0.12.1-py3-none-any.whl` is a local runtime wheel built from
`ramannanda9/agent-harness` commit `c06e0a9ebbbd50543dbf6463201ac07887d5e03e`.

It is included so Docker builds do not need to clone GitHub. The upstream MIT
license is preserved at `third_party/agent-harness/LICENSE`. Regenerate this
wheel only from the pinned commit and verify the package version before replacing it.
